items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: He sang with Mary Gardner and other singers.

ctx.x: I tell it to start from when you come down here. Is that what you want? Well, I'd like to know how old he is, too. Well, tell them how old you are. You all right? I'm going on 90. I'm going on 90. I'm going on 90. I'm going on 90. That's right. Listen, my mother and father, my father was a concert singer.
He sang with Mary Gardner and other singers. He sang also with a Philadelphia Philharmonic orchestra. My mother was a fine pianist. And they sang before the King and Queens in Crystal Palace, London.
